I fixed the type error in `src/index.ts` by changing the value `8417` to the string `"8417"`, so it matches the declared `string` type. `node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` now passes. No other file in `src` references `label`, so nothing else is affected.

If you wanted `label` to be a number, change the annotation to `number` instead.
